Package Name: Ransomware that resembles the Rancoz Ransomware
Method of Attack: Encrypts files on compromised machines adding .rec_rans or .buddyransome extensions
Deletes shadow copies using vssadmin.exe to prevent recovery
Deletes and resets specific registry keys to block remote recovery
Steals information and extorts money via ransom demands
Replaces desktop wallpaper with ransom note prompt
result.Attack Vector: Unknown, likely similar to other ransomware groups, possibly phishing or other common ransomware infection vectors
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note contains URL to TOR data leak site and attacker contact email
